system.description:
• Effect: Your marked prey counts as your favoured enemy for damage.
  • Every hit against it, not only the first each round, deals the Favoured Enemy extra weapon damage die and ignores its resistance, and your Combat Marauder bonus applies against it in full, whatever its type.
  • When your marked prey drops to 0 HP, you may mark another creature you can see as part of your next attack, without spending a use of Marked Prey.
  • Against a marked favoured enemy the extra die is still one die per hit.

rules.value: Relentless Hunter: every hit on your marked prey deals the Favoured Enemy extra weapon die and ignores its resistance (one die per hit against a marked favoured enemy), and Combat Marauder applies in full.
